content:
maria: Quick proposal: change metrics schema to reduce label cardinality and add token-level latency breakdowns. Proposing a new metric family 'redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds' with labels: model, region, route_group, kernel, batch_bucket, kv_hit (yes/no), quant, metric_schema=2. Plan: emit v1 + v2 in parallel for 14 days, collect cardinality telemetry, then flip. Thoughts?

tyler: sgtm but watch route_group. how do we map route_id -> route_group? some routes are per-customer and explode cardinality.

anika: avoid customer_id/route_id as labels. use route_group (business area) or hashed route token if we need uniqueness. bucket batch_size (1,2-4,5-16,17+) to keep combinations small.

oliver: quick concern: adding kernel + batch_bucket could create a lot of series. need an estimate from perf runs before we emit. also kernel naming needs standardization (e.g., 'fp16','q4','q8','f32').

maria: agree on kernel naming. early perf profile: median token latency ~18ms, p95 ~120ms. KV hit reduces median by ~6ms. I'll paste a tiny prometheus example below.

perf-bot: Profile summary (2024-11-26): tokens=1_000_000; kernels observed=[f32,fp16,q4]; unique_routes=350; estimated unique series with proposed labels ~8.4k. Branch metrics-v2 test showed +2% tail latency on one kernel combo.

tyler: two mitigations: (1) only emit kernel label when kernel != default (drop default to reduce series), (2) only emit batch_bucket (not raw batch_size). also add metric_schema label for easier query migrations.

anika: dashboards: per-route KPIs should include token_latency_p50/p95/p99, tokens_per_sec, kv_hit_rate, avg_batch_size. cap per-route dashboard to top N routes by traffic and provide table view for long tail.

oliver: rollout plan suggestion: emit both schemas for 14 days, collect cardinality + ingestion CPU, alarm if unique series > 20k, then flip and remove v1 after a cool-down. schedule a Prometheus scale test in staging.

maria: I'll draft the RFC + PR. example metric line to include in the PR for infra tests:
```
redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds{model="rw-7b",region="us-west1",route_group="search",kernel="q4",batch_bucket="2-4",kv_hit="yes",quant="q4",metric_schema="2"} 0.012
```
I'll open the RFC and ping infra + dashboards. thanks all :rocket:
